description:
Hi,

Greetings

Hope you are doing great!

I would like to update you on an urgent open position with our esteemed client. Please go through the Job Description. Send me your updated resume and expected rate for the below position

Role: Technology Analyst – J2EE/Web Services (Interview on 19th August)
Duration: Full Time
Location: Minneapolis, MN

Qualifications
Basic
• Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education
• At least 2 years of experience with Information Technology

Preferred
• At least 2 years of experience in Core JAVA, J2EE, Spring skills. 
• At least 2 years of experience in web programming using HTML5, JavaScript, and CSS in application development, maintenance and testing.
• Knowledge of languages like Perl Scripting , JQuery, ASP, AJAX , FLASH etc. would be an added advantage. 
• Demonstrated usage of Web 2.0 tools for development and testing.
• Knowledge of integration with databases like MySQL, Oracle, DB2.
• Knowledge on development and source control tools such as Maven and GIT. 
• At least 2 years of experience in software development life cycle. Prior work experience in Agile methodology desirable.
• Strong Analytical skills 
• At least 2 years of experience in translating functional/non-functional requirements to system requirements and technical designs.
• Excellent written & verbal communication 
• Experience working with offshore/onshore resources
• Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills.
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment
• Domain knowledge of Brokerage/Banking/Financial Services


 • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
